description: Words that may never confirm a shadow-sport (hockey, basketball, volleyball) opponent on their own in SHADOW_SETTLE's one-word rule (bet.sofa.resolve.shadow_opponent_agrees). Two different clubs share them: a place several clubs are named after (Hapoel / Maccabi Tel Aviv, Texas A&M / Texas A&M Commerce), or a word saying what a club is. The rule also needs a word of 5+ letters and the searched team's own name to pass the full score. Read in addition to resolve._GENERIC_NAME_TOKENS. Plan 2026-10-05, part 4B (B2).
